summary.ko: 승인된 코드의 데이터 흐름과 신뢰 경계에서 재현 가능한 보안 문제를 찾습니다.
summary.en: Review authorized code and trust boundaries for concrete security weaknesses and fixes.

required_inputs.description: Authorized code or architecture and the exact review boundary
Data sensitivity, trust boundaries, and intended actors

workflow.instruction: Map entry points, sensitive operations, untrusted inputs, and trust boundaries for the specified target.
Inspect authentication, authorization, injection, secret handling, error leakage, and unsafe dependencies where relevant.
Report only evidence-backed findings with affected paths, realistic preconditions, impact, and remediation; label unconfirmed hypotheses.
Suggest safe local regression tests and prioritize fixes without performing live exploitation.

deliverables.name: Security review
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each finding includes evidence, preconditions, impact, remediation, and confidence

deliverables.name: Fix verification plan
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Uses safe local tests and separates unknowns from confirmed issues

limitations: A limited code review is not a penetration-test certification.
Current dependency vulnerability claims require a current authoritative source or must be labeled unverified.
permission_boundaries: No external scanning, credential attacks, production exploitation, or access expansion.
Never disclose discovered secrets; identify their location and recommend the authorized rotation path.
